subject.title: Tool-call progress messages not retired/collapsed after completion (2026.6.9)

question: Should maintainers require live Telegram or Discord proof before landing the linked observer-fallback fix?
rationale: The source-level fix path is clear, but the user-visible bug is channel progress cleanup and the candidate PR is currently waiting on proof that a contributor cannot trigger without maintainer help.

options.title: Trigger live channel proof
options.body: Have a maintainer run Mantis or another live Telegram/Discord validation for the linked PR before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Land the linked PR on focused source tests and CI while explicitly accepting the missing live transport proof.

recommendation.title: Trigger live channel proof
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer run Mantis or another live Telegram/Discord validation for the linked PR before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the terminal-presentation feature history and best positioned to decide proof sufficiency for this runtime/channel boundary.
